author: Good Enough
description:
During the Cold War, the CIA developed some of the strangest weapons ever created, including devices designed to leave almost no evidence behind.

One of the most infamous examples was a compact weapon built to fire a tiny hidden projectile during covert operations without immediately drawing attention. After it was publicly revealed, it became one of the most controversial spy devices associated with Cold War espionage.

This Short explores the unsettling story behind the CIA’s so-called “heart attack weapon” and why it shocked the world when it was exposed.
